objective: Test whether a lower-variance, abstention-heavy purchase policy using frozen NL2 and B1a probabilities can generalize after economics-v1 failed untouched validation. The failed v1 holdout is development-only in this new lineage and is never reused as fresh validation.
failure_informed_but_nonconfirmatory_des: Economics-v1 development selected a policy by pooled ROI and then collapsed from +54.36% development ROI to -53.13% on its fresh untouched holdout.
The v1 holdout had only 1/5 positive meetings, 31.72% maximum drawdown, and a fully negative whole-race bootstrap ROI interval.

V2 therefore changes the purchase-policy family toward fewer markets, one total ticket per race, stricter probability/price edge thresholds, model-agreement control, and meeting-robust development selection. These are development hypotheses, not validated conclusions.
validation_target_selection_note: The five meeting identities and exact Kdreams track circumferences were fixed before v2 development settlement scoring. Schedule/track verification did not score target economics. Validation must fail closed on any collision with prior model/economics evidence.

selection_semantics.enumeration: For each fixed meeting enumerate day_index 01..04 and race_no 01..12; retain every race whose mandatory PRE parse and confirmed closing-price parse both pass; no replacement after settlement access.

purchase_policy_family.description: Low-degree-of-freedom robustness family. Use agreement between frozen NL2 and B1a, suppress long odds, abstain aggressively, and place at most one flat-100-yen ticket in a race.

development_selection.no_eligible_policy_rule: If no candidate is eligible, persist NO_DEVELOPMENT_ELIGIBLE_POLICY and do not fetch any v2 validation target.

validation_gate.C5_bootstrap: 10000 whole-race bootstrap replicates, seed 20260913, 95% ROI lower bound > 0
validation_gate.POSITIVE_BUT_UNCERTAIN: coverage and C1-C4 pass but C5 fails
validation_gate.FAIL: coverage passes and any of C1-C4 fails

phase_firewall: All v2 validation meeting identities are frozen here before v2 development settlement scoring.
Development PRE and PRICE are parsed and locked before development SETTLEMENT scoring.
The selected development policy must be atomically persisted before any v2 validation target fetch.
Validation PRE/PRICE and ticket decisions are frozen before validation SETTLEMENT parser invocation.
No validation-derived retune, replacement, threshold change, market change, deletion, rescue scoring, or reuse of economics-v1 failed holdout as fresh validation is allowed.
No DEV2000 RESULT/PAYOUT and no ECON_HOLDOUT1000 bytes may be opened by this lineage.
scientific_claim_boundary: Even PASS is historical KR-015 economics evidence only. It does not authorize Runtime, live orders, automatic betting, or real-money wagering.
